text:
Grab's full-time headcount increased from 11,267 at the end of 2024 to 12,012 at the end of 2025, a net rise of 745 employees (about 6.6%) [Grab, FY2024, p.161; Grab, FY2025, p.117].

Details by function:
- General & administrative: 1,425 → 1,375 (down 50)
- Sales & marketing: 853 → 785 (down 68)
- Operations, support & supermarket retail: 6,055 → 6,888 (up 833)
- Research & development: 2,934 → 2,964 (up 30)

The 2025 total includes 865 employees from the Everrise supermarket chain (acquired March 2025) and 22 from Infermove (acquired December 2025), while the 2024 total included 321 employees from Nham24 (acquired December 2024) [Grab, FY2024, p.161; Grab, FY2025, p.117]. In addition to full-time staff, Grab also had 1,242 fixed-term contract employees and 3,956 temporary agency workers as of end-2025, versus 1,299 fixed-term contract employees and 3,795 temporary agency workers as of end-2024 [Grab, FY2024, p.161; Grab, FY2025, p.117].
The headcount grew by approximately 6.6% year-over-year.

answer: The headcount grew by approximately 6.6% year-over-year.
